action.objective: Verify the reserved suggestion d6b8 (Qb8+) as the best queen follow-up after Qxd6, checking king safety and material.
action.rationale: Broad search at depth 2 gave d6b8 an exact score 2875, the top candidate, with PV Qb8+ Kf7 Qxb7+ Kg8 dxe4. It keeps the queen active and wins a pawn while Black's king is exposed. Alternatives d6e5/d6e6 were upper-bound only. I'll spend the reserved 2000 nodes verifying d6b8 at full depth.
